analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 47.4 attempts to consolidate in neutral territory after exiting oversold. MACD histogram shows improvement. Despite attempts to rebound after five consecutive down days, volume remains subdued. ADX at 29.3 indicates no clear trend formation. The current price of $406.00, down 16.9% from its 52-week high, is trading below the 50-day EMA of $420.72. Resistance at the 50-day EMA needs confirmation.
